caption: Paytm MITRA · the AI button for the Soundbox
say: This is MITRA. One new button for the Paytm Soundbox, built by team RivenDevs.

caption: "Anna, mango lassi irukka?"   "Illa-mma."
say: Meet Naren. He runs Naren Stores in Velachery. A couple walks up and asks for mango lassi. He does not have it, so he says, illa. They smile, and walk to the big cafe down the road. No payment happened, so nothing was recorded. For every system Naren owns, that sale never existed.

caption: Payment data only sees what already sold
say: This is the blind spot. Every Q R code and every payments dashboard knows what sold. None of them knows what a customer asked for, and did not get.

caption: Press the AI button once. It listens, logs, and advises.
say: Every Paytm merchant already has a Soundbox. MITRA adds an A I button. The owner presses it once, and confirms a notice is on display. Now it listens at the counter, in any of India's twenty two languages. It heard the customer ask, and heard him say no. It logged the missed sale by itself, then spoke a recommendation in Tamil. The audio is deleted at once.

caption: Asks are not sales: a cautious trial, priced by tested code
say: In the app, those asks become an opportunity. MITRA sizes a small, safe first batch, and shows what he puts in and what he earns. The A I only understands language. Every rupee is computed by tested code.

caption: Staff propose. Only the owner approves. Then the proof.
say: Staff can propose a trial, but only the owner can approve the spend. Afterwards he records what really sold, and sees predicted against actual profit.

caption: A missed ask becomes a paid pre-order
say: And the next customer who asks does not hear, illa. She gets a pre-order link, scans it, and pays.

caption: The Soundbox announces it, like it always has
say: The Soundbox announces the payment, just as it does today. This demo uses a clearly labelled Paytm sandbox. With a merchant I D, the same code calls Paytm.

caption: What sold + what didn't = a shop that plans ahead
say: Because MITRA knows both what sold and what did not, it forecasts the week, warns before cash runs short, and spots regular customers who have stopped coming.

caption: Sarvam AI in the cloud · our own MITRA-Lite offline
say: Under the hood, speech, understanding and voice all run on Sarvam A I. And for shops with no internet, we fine tuned our own small model, MITRA Lite, which runs fully offline.

caption: A paid add-on for Paytm for Business merchants
say: For Paytm, this is a paid add-on on hardware merchants already own, and a demand signal that no payment rail has.

caption: The Soundbox tells you what sold. The AI button tells you what you missed.
say: The Soundbox tells you what sold. The A I button tells you what you missed. That is MITRA. Thank you.
